guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation page with data tables that do not overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Intrinsic sizing; scrollable treatment (overflow:auto) for long unbreakable content; wrap wide tables.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto}, overflow-wrap:anywhere on table cells/h1/lede, pre{overflow-x:auto}.

guidanceConsulted.query: MDN-style API reference page with IDL syntax blocks and compatibility table responsive mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic HTML structure, real table semantics (th/scope), landmarks; accessibility is the floor not the ceiling.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: scope=row cells, thead on column-header tables, single h1/main, list markup for requirement sets, iframe title.
